name: macos-secrets-stay-in-vault
purpose: On macos, after pairing and granting, the device credential and the grant are only in the user secret store.

given.text: the HashRelay cloud is running with workspace w1
the HashRelay agent is installed per user on macos, by a non-administrator
the agent is paired to workspace w1 through the device-authorization flow as endpoint e1
the user secret store is available
the person grants one-click decisions to this device after signing in

when.text: the agent exports a diagnostic bundle

then.text: the user secret store holds the device credential and the decision grant
no configuration file, log or the bundle contains the credential or the grant
